fullDescription: A high-end, elegant Italian gastronomy design system featuring a deep charcoal and black 'dark mode' aesthetic accented with luxurious gold and terracotta tones. The style utilizes premium editorial typography (Zodiak Serif) and modern sans-serif (Plus Jakarta Sans). Key features include 3D-perspective hero elements, glassmorphism navigation, staggered bento-style grids for storytelling, and sophisticated hover effects. Ideal for fine dining restaurants, luxury hospitality brands, artisanal bakeries, or premium food & beverage e-commerce.

structured.summary: An upscale Italian restaurant digital experience called Delizoso, characterized by a sophisticated dark theme, floating 3D culinary imagery, and a blend of classic serif elegance with modern UI interactivity. The design prioritizes generous whitespace, high-contrast gold accents, and smooth, playful micro-interactions that suggest a premium, artisanal quality.

style.description: The style is 'Modern Heritage Luxury.' It pairs a deep, matte black background (#0A0A0A) with rich gold accents (#D4AF37). Typography relies on 'Zodiak' for a bold, high-contrast serif look and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for clean legibility. Animations are fluid, featuring 3D transforms, parallax-like floating effects, and spring-based scaling (cubic-bezier).
style.prompt: Create a design system with a dark color palette: primary background #0A0A0A, card surfaces #141414, and metallic gold accents #D4AF37 / #F4A460. Typography: Use 'Zodiak' serif for H1-H3 (H1: 6xl to 8xl, weight: 700, tracking: tight) and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for body and labels (weights: 400-600). Navigation should be a glassmorphism bar (95% opacity #0A0A0A with 10px backdrop-blur). UI elements should have rounded corners (3xl or 24px-32px). Include a '3D floating' effect using a specific shadow-drop filter (0 25px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)) and a hover transform of translateY(-15px) rotate(2deg) scale(1.05) using a cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275) curve. Use letter-spacing of 0.3em to 0.5em for uppercase labels to create a premium feel.

layout_and_structure.description: The layout is a single-page sophisticated scroll experience with a centered logo navigation, a split-screen 3D hero, and a staggered dish showcase grid.

prompts.prompt: Sticky glassmorphism header (#0A0A0A 95% + 10px blur). Centered logo featuring a large serif font 'DELIZOSO' with a gold uppercase sub-label 'RISTORANTE' (tracking 0.4em). Left side has 'Menu' and 'Specials' links in tracking-widest sans-serif. Right side features a user account icon/text and a primary 'Reservations' CTA button in #D4AF37 gold with black text, rounded-full.

Two-column grid. Left side: Small gold tracking-widest tag, followed by a massive H1 serif title ('Delizioso — Italian Cuisine' with 'Italian Cuisine' in italics), a white/60% opacity paragraph, and two pill-shaped buttons (Primary: White with Black text; Secondary: Outlined). Right side: A 3D perspective container containing a large circular dish image (550px) with a heavy drop shadow. Add two floating floating UI badges: one 'Best Rated' badge with a gold icon and a 'Signature Dish' badge rotated -6 degrees.

A staggered grid of 3-4 cards. Each card is #141414 background with 3xl rounded corners. The top half is a high-quality 4:5 aspect ratio image that scales on hover. Bottom half contains the Dish name (Serif), Price (Gold), and a short description (white/50%). Include an 'Add to order' text link with a plus icon in gold.

Bento-style 2-column layout. Left: A mosaic of two images (one 300px height, one 400px height) with a gold card nestled between them displaying a '12+' years metric. Right: Editorial layout with 'Our Visionary' tag, large serif H2 title, italicized blockquote, and body text. Include an SVG signature element (white/70% opacity) above the chef's name and title.

Four-column dark layout. Column 1-2: Large serif logo and brief brand mission. Column 3: 'Hours of service' with justify-between list items. Column 4: 'Visit us' with gold Lucide icons for location, phone, and email. Bottom bar: Horizontal list of privacy links (left) and copyright (right) in white/20% uppercase text.

special_ui_components.description: The centerpiece interaction that creates depth.
special_ui_components.prompt: Apply a perspective-1000px container to a large circular image. Add a 'floating' animation using a 3s bounce keyframe. On hover, apply transform: translateY(-15px) rotate(2deg) scale(1.05) with a transition-duration of 500ms. Place a gold radial blur (#D4AF37 at 5% opacity) behind the plate with a blur radius of 120px to simulate ambient light.

special_ui_components.description: A fixed bottom navigation for high conversion on mobile devices.
special_ui_components.prompt: A centered fixed pill (bottom-6) made of #141414 glassmorphism. Inside, two equal-sized buttons: 'Menu' (White bg, Black text) and 'Book' (Gold bg, Black text). Both buttons must be rounded-full, uppercase, bold, and tracking-widest.
